text: Figure 7.25: Model of a server call point. For example, let’s consider the case of an asynchronous call to a remote operation where the RTE is supposed to trigger a speciﬁc RunnableEntity when the opera- tion completes. The description of the corresponding AtomicSwComponentType would typically contain the following elements: 1. The AtomicSwComponentType contains an RPortPrototype ‘myPort’ typed by a PortInterface that in turn contains the deﬁnition of an ClientServer- Operation ‘remoteOperation’. 2. The AtomicSwComponentType’s SwcInternalBehavior contains at least two RunnableEntitys: the RunnableEntity ‘main’ is supposed to invoke the operation; the RunnableEntity ‘callback’ is the one that should be called when the operation completes. 3.
